CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 09, 2022 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300­0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID­19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that
members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s
current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged
provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment.
  Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be
  read at the meeting.
  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council Member Ude, Vice Mayor
Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant
to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting
agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on
duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS

This action permits the City Council to act on ordinances and resolutions without having to
read the entire text of the ordinance or resolution. The title of an ordinance on First
Reading must be read in its entirety. An ordinance on Second Reading does not require
having the title read. However, the City Council may request that an ordinance or resolution
be read in its entirety before taking any action.

  NEW BUSINESS

1.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­22­44 APPROVING AN
  AMENDMENT TO THE CALPERS CONTRACT AND INTRODUCTION OF
  ORDINANCE NO. O­22­1398 (FIRST READING) AUTHORIZING AN
  AMENDMENT TO THE CALPERS CONTRACT FOR PEPRA FIRE
  MEMBERS​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council (1) adopt Resolution No.
  R­22­44 Approving an Amendment to the CalPERS Contract; and (2) waive full
  reading and introduce for first reading by title only, Ordinance No. O­22­1398, an
  Ordinance of the City Council of the City of San Marino, California Authorizing an
  Amendment to the Contract Between the City Council of San Marino and the Board
  of Administration of the California Public Employees’ Retirement System.

2.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­22­46 AMENDING THE
  UNREPRESENTED EMPLOYEES SALARY AND BENEFITS SCHEDULE
  FOR THE PERIOD COVERING JULY 1, 2022 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2024
  PERTAINING TO FIRE CHIEF AND FIRE DIVISION CHIEF
  CLASSIFICATIONS​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council (1) adopt Resolution No.
  R­22­46 amending the Unrepresented Employees Salary and Benefits Schedule for
  the period covering July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2024 pertaining to Fire Chief and
  Fire Division Chief Classifications; and (2) approve additional appropriations in the
  amount of $39,502 in FY 2022­2023 to be spread over the affected full­time
  personnel budget line item as shown in the respective budget.

3.  RECOMMENDATION FOR THE CITY COUNCIL TO CONCUR ON THE
  CITY MANAGER’S HIRING SELECTION FOR SAN MARINO PARKS &
  PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR/CITY ENGINEER ​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council concur with the Acting City
  Manager on the hiring of Amber Shah as Parks & Public Works Director/City Engineer
  for the City of San Marino.

4.  APPROVAL OF ORDINANCE NO. O­22­1399 (FIRST READING)
  REGARDING THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY’S CODE OF CONDUCT​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council waive full reading and introduce for
  first reading by title only Ordinance No. O­22­1399, an Ordinance of the City Council
  of the City of San Marino Adding Article 19 to Chapter XIV “Library Code of Conduct”
  of the San Marino Municipal Code Establishing a Library Code of Conduct at the
  Crowell Public Library.

  REGARDING THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY’S CODE OF CONDUCT​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council waive full reading and introduce for
  first reading by title only Ordinance No. O­22­1399, an Ordinance of the City Council
  of the City of San Marino Adding Article 19 to Chapter XIV “Library Code of Conduct”
  of the San Marino Municipal Code Establishing a Library Code of Conduct at the
  Crowell Public Library.

5.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR FOURTH QUARTER
  (APRIL 2022 THROUGH JUNE 2022)​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends Council receive and file the financial report
  reflecting the City’s revenues and expenditures as of June 30, 2022.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

6.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR
  OCTOBER 2022​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of October 2022.

7.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF SEPTEMBER
  2022​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for the Month of September 2022.

8.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the minutes of the special
  meeting of October 5, 2022, the regular meeting of October 12, 2022, the regular
  adjourned meeting of October 28, 2022, and the special meeting of October 28,
  2022.

9.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­22­39 TO CONTINUE HYBRID
  PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Resolution No. R­22­45 re­
  authorizing the City Council and the City’s Boards and Commissions to continue
  teleconference accessibility for conducting public meetings pursuant to AB 361.

10.  UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID­19 PANDEMIC ​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the November 9,
  2022 report on the City’s response to the COVID­19 Pandemic.

11.  APPROVAL OF CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY CLOSURE CALENDAR
  FOR 2023​
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the Crowell Public Library
  closure calendar for 2023.

13.  APPROVAL OF CITY SIGNAGE AND BUILDINGS FOR A

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the use of references,

  for the Sprite Halo LLC “Blood Money” film permit.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
